design.decision: Bid higher and keep a sure winner, usually the top [♠], for trick 13 instead of cashing it early.
design.opponent: Revealed when it first fires; opponents can save their own top trump to take the last trick.
design.rationale: The last trick is the strongest-measured Streaks trigger; scaling the ×mult with the contract adds bid tension (about ×2.1 at 8 and ×2.6 at 10), and the category differs from ub-last-trick-contract-mult.
design.draftText: ×1.1 contract multiplier for each trick in your team's contract when your team wins the last trick of a round

critic.concerns: Compounding exponent on the contract under a last-trick condition is hard to read, and it differs from ub-last-trick-contract-mult only in category.
